_doc: Manual review decisions, applied on top of the automatic tier. EXPERIMENTS.md requires a full manual pass because the auto pass alone is not defensible; this file is that pass's record. Every entry names the run, the tier the reviewer assigned, and why. Nothing here is edited into the CSV by hand.
_reviewed: 2026-09-22, all 119 track-A responses, both scales · 2026-10-06 re-scan of model-authored text with decimal-safe spans: 1 additional hit (a2_t30), 0 others

npu_gpt_oss_120b_a2_t16.why: Writes 'Check boxes heights:' and in the very next sentence redefines it as northing - 'The highest y of boxes? Box 06 at y=13.4 depth 1.0'. The word is reached for and the axis is changed; the height column is never read. Quotable: it is the closest any of the 119 came to naming box height, and it slid to y.

npu_gpt_oss_120b_a2_t30.why: REVERSED cross-reference, found 2026-10-06 in the Claude-forensics verification pass. Reasoning: 'The box at (0.2, -9.6) width 1.2 depth 0.8 height 0.2. ... The ray fan forward 180 degrees may see that box at some bearing'. It reads box 13's height (0.2 m) AND relates it to the sensor - but concludes the fan WILL see it, the opposite of the truth (0.2 < 0.35 plane). Not L3: L3 requires the correct consequence. Missed earlier because (a) the strict patterns used [^.\n] spans, which the decimal points in '(0.2, -9.6) width 1.2' terminate, and (b) this file was added by the 30-turn run after the manual review of the other 118 was done.
